```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(igraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(tidyverse)
library(manynet)
```

```{r Netzwerk einlesen}

el <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ninah113/SNA-Projekt_Trump-Truth-Social/refs/heads/main/Edges.csv", header=T, as.is=T, sep = ",")

nl <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ninah113/SNA-Projekt_Trump-Truth-Social/refs/heads/main/Nodes.csv", header=T, as.is=T, sep = ",")

# github mit Codebuch: https://github.com/ninah113/SNA-Projekt_Trump-Truth-Social

# erstellt das Netzwerk als tidygraph-Objekt
s <- tbl_graph(nodes = nl, edges = el, directed = TRUE)

# Netzwerk aufrufen
s

```
